Package com.dfiles.service

Class AiScriptService

java.lang.Object
com.dfiles.service.AiScriptService
public final class AiScriptService extends Object
Turns a plain-English instruction into a bash script using an OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions API. Two backends are supported via AiProvider: OpenAI's own hosted API, and a local Llamafile server — both speak the same request/response JSON shape, so one implementation serves either.

The OpenAI API key is read from the OPENAI_API_KEY environment variable at call time only; it is never stored, cached or logged. The JDK's own HttpClient is used, so no extra HTTP dependency is needed.

  • Method Details

    • generateScript

      public static String generateScript(String prompt, AiProvider provider) throws IOException, InterruptedException
      Requests a bash script for prompt from provider. Blocking — callers must run this off the JavaFX Application Thread.
      Parameters:
      prompt - the user's plain-English description of the script they want
      provider - which backend to call
      Returns:
      the generated script text, with any markdown code fences stripped and a # Generated by DFiles using <provider>, model: <model> comment inserted after the shebang line (the model name comes from the response itself, not the request, since that's the actual model that produced the script)
      Throws:
      IOException - if the provider is unreachable, returns a non-200 response, or (for AiProvider.OPENAI) no API key is configured
      InterruptedException - if the calling thread is interrupted while waiting on the request
